models.evidence: RTX 5090 (gb202) and RTX 4090 (ad102) 2026-09-28: the NemotronH MTP head (bartowski's mtp-*.gguf, converted by nemotron_h_mtp_published) drafting for the nemotron_h engine through a separate drafter artifact. mtp:2 on both GPUs: on the RTX 4090 K=2 is the fastest at C=1 (329.1 tok/s, K=3 327.8, K=4/5 lose); on the RTX 5090 K=3 decodes 1.5 % faster at C=1 (405.8 against 399.8, 0.25 % slower in an earlier run) but loses at C=4 (735.1 against 742.2 aggregate), so the choice stays K=2 (acceptance 66.2 %, 2.32 tokens per round). The Q4_0 head accepts about what the Q8_0 head does (RTX 4090, K=2: 67.8 % against 68.7 %) and runs 2 % faster (329.1 against 323.0 tok/s) at half the memory (0.77 against 1.46 GB), so the Q4_0 file is the one fetched. The watchdog floor is left at the default: on the earlier, 53-layer RTX 5090 target (below) a floor measured at C=1 (1.81 tokens per round) tripped requests at 58-66 % acceptance that then rode speculative batches as plain rows (C=2 516 against 585 tok/s). The gb202 target is unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL converted with the trunk mapper that leaves out the MTP block the GGUF folds into block_count (nemotron_h_moe/2; before it the target had a 53rd, attention layer after the trunk, and a target of 53 layers now takes no drafter): 52 layers whose kinds equal the HF config's layers_block_type; greedy under --activations exact against llama.cpp on the same GGUF, 4 raw prompts x 64 tokens: two identical, two diverging at near-ties (prompt 2 at token 34: llama.cpp ' sky' over ' sun' by 0.090 nats, ninferno ' sun' over ' sky' by 0.11-0.14; prompt 3 at token 9: '9' / '6' within 0.0005 nats in llama.cpp, which picks either by device, 0.07-0.12 in ninferno); bartowski's Q4_0 on the RTX 4090 diverges from llama.cpp at near-ties as well (prompts 0, 1, 3 at gaps of 0.018-0.030 nats in llama.cpp; ninferno's top two there are the same pair, 0.23-0.25, 0.01-0.07 and 0.02-0.05 nats apart). Both repositories match by repository; the entry's geometry is the HF config's (52 layers). ninferno-serve with the table, C=1/2/4/8 aggregate tok/s (plain / --spec-load none / table): RTX 5090 UD-Q4_K_XL 312/401/402, 437/596/582, 640/737/758, 785/913/918; RTX 4090 Q4_0 239/330/326, 363/491/481, 537/644/637, 659/777/772
